responsibility: This header declares the graph-management API for gm2’s runtime-exception reachability analysis. It exposes creation and lookup of rtenode objects, inclusion of nodes in the all/candidate/extern/constructor sets, recording of call edges and current function context, retrieval of associated function decls, and lifecycle/discovery entry points for the analysis implemented in rtegraph.cc.
same_name_distinction: Header half of the rtegraph pair: it provides the forward declaration of rtenode and the public entry points for node lookup, graph population, reachability discovery, and lifecycle management, while the graph structure and propagation/diagnostic algorithms live in rtegraph.cc.
